value.rationale: The exact homotopy classification is an infinite-family equivariant fixed-set result for the first scale-three nontrivial coordinate-weight translation orbit. It exposes nontrivial free π1 in fixed-point sets of ambient simply connected scale-three Rips complexes and determines all integral homology. The result is not only an Euler-character or routine homology-character calculation and distinguishes fixed-space topology from the already known ambient representation.
